body:
Implementation issue for the SET-REMAINDER of #1858 (origin issue — it stays open as the tracker for this set). Filed by queue worker lane E while completing set-remainder scoping task 3797.

Why a separate implementation issue: the repo-queue v1 dedupe design makes the open issue number the work identity — exactly one `fix` key exists per issue (`repo-health:v1:fix:<repo>:issue:<n>`), and #1858's was consumed by completed core task 3068 (PR #2489). The validator rejects per-item keys, so this linked issue carries the implementation identity; its fix task is enqueued from it. #1858 remains the set tracker per the cross-repo set rule.

## State of the set
PR #2489 (merged 2026-10-30, 069aff53) landed the v2 core only: `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/v2/` = {id, setup}, options, session-env, context hook, ctx.storage remembered daemon, timing, namespaced tool.transform. Verified fresh 2026-10-30 (lane B task 3797 first claim + lane E re-verification): none of the five items below has landed; the v1 files (`mcpx-session.ts`, `mcpx-tui.tsx`, `mcpx/`) still sit beside the v2 tree; `v2/tools.ts` header (lines 24-27) itself names item (2) as SET-REMAINDER work.

## Items — work strictly one at a time, own branch + PR each, PR references #1858 and this issue
Order: (2) → (1) → (4) → (3) → (5).

- [ ] **(2) permission.hook("evaluate")** — the real v2 permission hook replacing v1's dead permission.ask. Today v2 `daemon_select` applies the choice it was told to apply with no confirmation (tools.ts header). Route mcpx tool permission prompts through the evaluate hook; update the tools.ts header when it lands.
- [ ] **(1) mcp.transform** — register a filtered MCP server set per session (named in #1858's "Also new in v2 and worth using" and docs/opencode-plugin-v2.md §6).
- [ ] **(4) ctx.generate.text** — wire it so the plugin can answer mcpx's MCP sampling questions.
- [ ] **(3) TUI select() daemon picker** — promise-based picker where the pinned v2 surface supports it, choice persisted via ctx.storage (remember.ts). If the pinned surface cannot support a true TUI select, land the closest supported equivalent and record the deviation + evidence here and on #1858.
- [ ] **(5) Retire the v1 plugin files** ("v2-only wins", recorded by triage task 2746) — only after (1)-(4) are landed or explicitly waived on #1858: remove or gate `pkgs/mcpx/plugin/opencode/mcpx-session.ts`, `mcpx-tui.tsx`, `mcpx/`; clear dangling references in pkgs/mcpx docs/README; record the outcome on #1858.

## Out of scope
- Daemon-side `_meta["ai.opencode/sessionID"]` attribution — #1932 owns it.
- The deployed `.opencode/plugin/` copy port — #730 owns it (coordinate there if the deployed copy still loads v1 at item (5)).

## Acceptance
Each item: targeted tests in the v2 tree, CI green on its PR, outcome noted on #1858. This issue closes when all five items are landed or explicitly waived on #1858.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each of the five SET-REMAINDER items from #1858 lands as its own branch + PR, in the stated order (2) → (1) → (4) → (3) → (5), each PR referencing #1858 and this issue
- [ ] Item (2): v2 implements permission.hook("evaluate") replacing v1's dead permission.ask path
- [ ] The v1 plugin files (mcpx-session.ts, mcpx-tui.tsx, mcpx/) are retired or explicitly dispositioned once the v2 items land
- [ ] #1858 is updated/closed as the set tracker when all five items are merged
